first_location_to_inspect: PTP grandmaster election (BMCA) at the O-DU/O-RU S-plane boundary
operator_response: Quarantine the unexpected GM; verify Announce source and BMCA attributes.

first_location_to_inspect: PTP packet stream on the Open Fronthaul transport path
operator_response: Block the replay source and reset/revalidate sequence continuity.

first_location_to_inspect: S-plane ingress/transport link before the O-DU PTP stack
operator_response: Rate-limit the offending source while preserving trusted timing traffic.

change: GNSS loss/jamming followed by oscillator holdover
first_location_to_inspect: GNSS receiver, antenna/RF feed, or local timing source
operator_response: Switch to a trusted clock/LLS-C source and inspect the GNSS RF chain.

first_location_to_inspect: GNSS time source; corroboration is required outside the receiver
operator_response: Cross-check with authenticated GNSS or an independent physical clock.

first_location_to_inspect: Fronthaul switches, queues, link scheduling, or competing traffic
operator_response: Inspect queue occupancy/QoS and reroute or reprioritize timing packets.

first_location_to_inspect: Fronthaul traffic source; not a timing attack by itself
operator_response: Observe unless timing quality also degrades; do not auto-quarantine.
Validate the maintenance/failover ticket and continue monitoring.

first_location_to_inspect: Ethernet Equipment Clock / SyncE distribution chain
operator_response: Trace QL advertisements and switch to the best available EEC source.

change: Benign GNSS loss entering specified holdover
first_location_to_inspect: GNSS availability/local oscillator (within declared holdover envelope)
operator_response: Monitor holdover duration and drift; escalate only on envelope violation.
